'''Squirtle''' (Japanese: '''ゼニガメ''' ''Zenigame'') is a character in [[Magical Pokémon Journey]]. He lives at {{MPJ|Wigglytuff}} and {{MPJ|Jigglypuff}}'s mansion and is apparently their butler. He can speak [[human]] language.

Squirtle has five sisters—two {{p|Blastoise}} named Kameko and Kamemi, a {{p|Wartortle}} named Kamena, and two younger Squirtle named Kameyo and Kamee.

==Personality and characteristics==
Since [[Almond]] was extremely nice to him at the [[PPP06|first Christmas party]], Squirtle greatly admires Almond and refers to him as his "big brother". Squirtle also seems to have a crush on Almond.
